## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.25.1

### XR0A-iR Radon Detector
- Adds the X-Sense home-card radon reading in Bq/m³, with 1-day, 7-day, 30-day, and 90-day averages, long-term day count, and peak.
- Creates battery, Wi-Fi, alarm, and end-of-life entities for the XR0A-iR station.
- Applies house mainpage state when X-Sense keys the station as `{model}-{serial}` instead of the bare serial.
- Keeps radon values in diagnostics downloads.

This is a pre-release. Latest stable remains v1.4.25.
